payload.title: [auth-saml-6] Single configured IdP certificate prevents zero-downtime signing-key rotation
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING auth-saml-6 (info/crypto, confidence=high, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/auth/saml.ts
LINES: 92-98, 446-492

WHAT: SamlProviderConfig.idpCertificate is a single string and the verifier pins exactly that cert (publicCert = pem, getCertFromKeyInfo = () => null — correctly never trusting document KeyInfo). There is no way to configure multiple trusted certs, so during an IdP signing-key rollover the SP must trust either the old or the new key but not both, forcing a hard cutover.

IMPACT: Operational: a cert rotation causes an authentication outage for any assertion signed with whichever key the SP isn't currently configured for. No security weakness (pinning itself is correct), just a rotation/availability limitation.

SUGGESTED FIX: Accept idpCertificate as a string OR string[] and verify each signature against the set, treating the signature as valid if it verifies under any configured cert. This permits overlapping old+new keys during rotation.
